info.title: ANTO-LTG Catalog API
info.description: Static, read-only JSON files generated from catalogs/ by `npm run build`. This is a research index: statuses, sources and retrieval dates must be read before a record is used in a critical workflow. It is not a live driver database and not a real-time API.

license.name: MIT (code); see LICENSING.md for data and third-party notices

get.description: Software that technicians commonly install, with sourced versions, hash-pinned installer URLs and declared compatibility. The file currently holds 394 items.
Driver source records: official packages, vendor tools, support portals and clearly labelled third-party leads. The file currently holds 44 items.
Official driver and support entry points per manufacturer, plus the domains that count as official for each. The file currently holds 21 items.
Scenario notes for technician tools. The file currently holds 26 items.
Curated starting selections of apps. The file currently holds 9 items.
Project and catalog update notes (also published as an RSS feed when SITE_URL is set). The file currently holds 4 items.

get.summary: Endpoint index with counts and SHA-256 of every file
Local image for every catalog record
get.description: Format anto-ltg.visuals/1. Maps each app, tool, driver, vendor, bundle and category ID to a file in assets/ and the fallback level that was used (brand, component, category, glyph or bundled). Photos are listed once with their responsive variants. Built from catalogs/ and assets/manifest.json; the files it points to are static.

get.summary: Inverted search index built at build time
get.description: Format anto-ltg.search-index/1. `docs` lists the searchable items, `tokens` is a sorted token list and `postings[i]` is a flat [docIndex, weight, ...] list for tokens[i].

Apps_app.title: App
Apps_app.description: A piece of software that technicians commonly install. Facts (version, downloads, compatibility) come from cited sources. publication says whether the machine rules passed; verification_status says whether a human reviewed it.

description.description: Short description in the source language (English for crawled records).

description_id.description: Optional Indonesian description written by a maintainer.

windows_compatibility.description: Outcome of a HUMAN compatibility review. 'not_reviewed' until someone has actually tested or researched it.

compatibility.description: What the SOURCE declares about Windows 10/11. Evidence-based; 'declared' is not a test result.

architectures.description: Architectures for which the source lists an installer. Empty means unknown.

winget_id.description: WinGet package identifier. Present only when the package exists in the winget source (proven by the crawler).

BundleManifest.title: ANTO-LTG portable bundle manifest
BundleManifest.description: The JSON a user exports from the Software Center. Importing it only restores a SELECTION of catalog ids: install commands are always regenerated from the current catalog, so a manifest can never inject a package identifier or a command.

BundlesCatalog.title: ANTO-LTG Bundles Catalog
BundlesCatalog.description: Curated starting selections of apps. A bundle only references app ids; it never carries package identifiers of its own.

Common_compatState.description: declared = the source states a minimum OS that the target meets (not a test result); unsupported = the source requires a newer OS; unknown = the source says nothing.

size_bytes.description: Size in bytes when the publisher states it exactly.

Common_id.description: Stable lowercase kebab-case identifier. Never reused for a different thing.

Common_publication.description: Machine-checked publication state. Separate from human review. 'published' means every rule in publication.mjs passed when this record was last generated; 'unavailable' means a later check (for example a link check or a removed WinGet package) found the record no longer meets the rules, and the record stays visible with a warning instead of silently disappearing.

method.description: automated = produced by a crawler adapter and published by the merge rules; maintainer_curated = written by a maintainer from official pages, then checked by the same rules.

checks.description: Rule ids that passed at checked_at.

problems.description: Rule ids that failed at checked_at (empty for published records).

Common_qualityFlags.description: Machine-readable data-quality warnings produced by the crawler (for example vendor_device_mismatch).

Common_review.description: Properties shared by every reviewable record.

Common_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 as published by the source. Never computed or guessed by this project.

Common_sha512.description: Lowercase hex SHA-512 as published by the source.

Common_source.description: Where some of a record's fields came from. 'fields' lists which top-level fields this source supplied, which is the per-field provenance.

Common_verificationStatus.description: HUMAN review status only. 'verified' means a maintainer checked the record against the official source and recorded reviewed_at, review_notes and an evidence_url. Automated publication never sets it: a record that no human has reviewed is 'not_reviewed', and that is normal for published records. See the 'publication' definition for machine-checked publication.

Common_version.description: Version exactly as published by the source, or null when no source states it reliably.

DriversCatalog.title: ANTO-LTG Drivers Catalog
DriversCatalog.description: Driver SOURCE records: pointers to official vendor pages and packages with whatever the source publishes. This is a research index, not a live driver database; the project never hosts or mirrors driver binaries.

publisher.description: Who publishes the driver or the page that lists it.

manufacturer.description: Maker of the hardware this applies to (for example Intel, Realtek, Dell).

vendor_id.description: Reference to an entry in vendors.json.

model.description: System model or hardware family; 'Unspecified' when the source does not say.

source_url.description: The page that describes this record (official support/download page, or the aggregator listing for third_party_aggregator records).

stable.description: true when the URL is expected to stay valid across releases.

architectures.description: Empty = the source does not say which architectures; it never means 'all'.

file_size_text.description: Size exactly as the source displays it (for example 23.09M). Not converted, because units are often ambiguous.

Proposals.title: ANTO-LTG crawler proposals
Proposals.description: What a crawler adapter writes to catalogs/proposed/<adapter>.proposals.json. Every record is a proposal for human review; a record's verification_status can only be not_reviewed.

key.description: Stable de-duplication key, for example winget:git.git.

ToolsCatalog.title: ANTO-LTG Technician Tools Catalog
ToolsCatalog.description: Scenario-oriented notes for tools that technicians reach for (diagnostics, recovery, boot media). A tool may point at an app record through app_id so that install options are not duplicated.

app_id.description: The apps.json record that carries the install options for this tool.

bootable_media.description: true when the tool runs from boot media rather than inside Windows.

path.description: Site-relative path beginning with exactly one slash.

VendorsCatalog.title: ANTO-LTG Vendor Directory
VendorsCatalog.description: Official driver and support entry points per manufacturer, with the domains that count as official for that vendor. Drivers whose official_source points outside the vendor's domains fail validation.

domains.description: Hostnames (or *.suffix) that belong to this vendor and are acceptable for official_source URLs.

requires.description: What the vendor's official portal typically asks for before it offers a download.

VisualsCatalog.title: ANTO-LTG Visual Map
VisualsCatalog.description: Generated by npm run build from catalogs/ and assets/manifest.json. Maps each catalog record to the local image it shows, with the fallback level that was used. Every entry points at a file in assets/; no entry points at a third-party server.

bundled.description: Vector fallbacks that every record can use. Each path must exist.
